memory_candidates.content: In KampBypass.lean, generalExistPart_from_classical CANNOT be used directly from the Until/Since zone implementation because GeneralExistPart.lean imports KampBypass.lean (circular dependency). Instead, inlined the classical satisfiability logic using sub_nf.2 ssn directly to determine top/bot. The forward direction (mpr) proved using NF agreement transfer (nf_agreement_from_shared_nf). The backward direction (mp) remains sorry due to the fundamental circularity: decoding top/bot formulas back to existential truth requires the 2-var NF as precondition, which is exactly what we are trying to prove.
